blocks.text: SMS Philippines Healthcare Solutions Inc. (SMS) celebrates a major milestone after taking home four awards at the Marketing Excellence Awards Philippines 2026, recognizing the agency’s work in developing impactful, insight-driven, and audience-focused marketing campaigns. The four wins span two of SMS’ notable campaigns. Rexona’s Move With Confidence National School Program received Gold for Excellence in Marketing to a Specific Audience and Silver for Excellence in Experiential Marketing, while Golden Fiesta’s Doctors’ Most Prescribed Canola Oil Claim earned two Silver awards for Excellence in Consumer Insights / Market Research and Excellence in Integrated Marketing.
